name: magpie-sim
description: Sim a crossword position in MAGPIE and browse the results in a pane, with a board picture of each play: /magpie <rack | CGP | .cgp/.gcg path or URL>. Installs MAGPIE itself on first use.

lexicon.title: Lexicon
lexicon.description: The lexicon a position is simmed in when it names none.

magpieDir.title: MAGPIE directory
magpieDir.description: Where MAGPIE is installed: a directory holding bin/magpie and data/. Empty is the one the mod installs it in: ~/.magpie, or %LOCALAPPDATA%\MAGPIE on Windows.
